prompt_text:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, photorealistic premium television commercial filmed with a 35 mm lens and shallow depth of field, with natural skin tones in soft warm practical lighting. A medium close-up frames a Chinese woman in her late twenties with long straight dark hair in a natural side part, minimal makeup and a warm, understated expression, wearing a loose beige T-shirt under a muted brown pinafore dress, from the chest up, seated at a wooden table in a softly lit home interior in the evening and turned three-quarters toward the camera. An open silver laptop stands on the table beside her at the right of the frame, its screen facing away from the camera, and a ceramic mug sits next to it. A warm floor lamp behind her at the left glows golden, and a shelf with a few books and a small plant is softly out of focus in the background. She holds a smartphone in her right hand at chest height, its screen facing away from the camera, and looks down at it. A gentle smile appears on her face, and she makes one small thumb movement on the screen as she responds. Her long dark hair falls naturally over one shoulder, and her expression stays warm and understated, her lips together. The camera holds a static shot for the whole duration, her face in sharp focus. There is no text anywhere in the frame.

overall_soundscape: Quiet domestic room tone with a subtle phone tap and the faint rustle of her T-shirt sleeve.

non_diegetic_music: Ambient electronic music at a slow tempo: sustained synth pads with a soft low pulse and a low, sustained bass note, kept low in volume.
